label: Codex surfacing depends on a manual per-entry hook approval stored in ~/.codex/config.toml, and INSTALL-SKILLED.md never mentions it, so a fresh external repo reaches Codex with no advisor brief.
DSH has two independent install blockers: its prompt-advisor defaults off without a repo config, and INSTALL-SKILLED.md omits dsh from both runtime lists.
A per-runtime brief head is localized: AdvisorBriefRenderOptions already carries runtime, the Claude hook already passes it, and only renderAdvisorBrief ignores it.
Pi is the only runtime where a brief-head A/B is clean, because its brief is in-prompt in 6 of 6 sampled sessions while Claude injects out of band and Codex is unapproved in the arena.
Every claimed start-rate gain is conditional on arm completeness and brief attribution, neither of which the scorer reports today while the pre-arm log keeps growing.

direction: Ship 005 and 006 and the start rate rises
reason: Planned work cannot be re-recommended, and it is unverifiable until arm completeness and brief attribution exist.

direction: Add the document path to every runtime's brief
reason: Claude and OpenCode resolve commands through their own surfaces, so the path only pays on hosts with no registry.
